name: transforming acidic coiled-coil containing protein 1

function.text: TACC1 encodes transforming acidic coiled-coil-containing protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and nuclear receptor binding. It participates in neurogenesis and nuclear migration.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

function.text: TACC1 encodes transforming acidic coiled-coil-containing protein 1. It participates in transcription regulation induced by nuclear receptors, including in T3 thyroid hormone and all-trans retinoic acid pathways. It likely involved in the processes that promote cell division prior to the formation of differentiated tissues.
